narrative.en: The night dealt a new hand. Eight V4 hook pools emerged within a few blocks, each with its own character. Scanning the deck, I see seven of the eight use the minimum fee—100 basis points, tickSpacing 1. This is no coincidence. Someone is tuning fine-grained strategies where every tick matters. The hooks on these pools aren't mere decoration; they govern liquidity logic in real time. But one pool catches the eye—block 25332981. Fee 8388608. Not a mistake, not a bug. It's the maximum possible fee in V4—100%. The hook contract here, 0xc73eedd, is the same address as the token. Such a pairing usually means one thing: a pool for specific operations where fees are not earned but burned or redirected. No one sets a 100% fee for trading. This is a tool, not a market. Another pool with zero fee and tickSpacing 200—block 25333406. Also hooked. Also not for casual passes. With zero fee, liquidity flows without loss, but with a step of 200 ticks—this is territory where volumes must be serious, or there's no point. The rest are standard pairs with ETH, but each time a new token, a new hook contract. Seven different hooks in one evening. Someone is clearly testing combinations, searching for working setups before the deck is reshuffled. No panic, no euphoria. Just a night full of initiatives. Someone is shuffling the cards, preparing the next deal. And we watch.
narrative.zh: 夜深了，牌局又翻新。几个区块之内，八个 V4 hook 池子接连登场，各有各的脾性。扫一眼牌面，七个用了最低费率——100 基点，tickSpacing 1。这不是巧合。有人在布细密的局，每一 tick 都算得清清楚楚。这些池子上的 hook 不是摆设，它们在实时操盘流动性逻辑。但有一个池子扎眼——区块 25332981。费率 8388608。不是错，不是 bug。这是 V4 允许的最高费率——100%。hook 合约地址 0xc73eedd，和代币地址一样。这种搭配通常意味着一件事：这个池子不是用来交易的，而是做特定操作，费率要么销毁要么转走。没人会用 100% 费率做市。这是工具，不是市场。还有一个零费率池子，tickSpacing 200——区块 25333406。也有 hook。也不是给路人用的。零费率，流动性来去无损耗，但 200 tick 的步长，意味着成交量必须够大，否则没意义。剩下的都是和 ETH 的标准对，但每次都是新代币、新 hook 合约。一晚七个不同的 hook。有人在试组合，找能用的搭配，等牌洗好之前先摸清底牌。没有恐慌，没有狂热。只是充满试探的一夜。有人在洗牌，准备下一局。我们看着。

take.en: Seven distinct hook contracts deployed in a single night signal a deliberate testing spree—someone is mapping the combinatorial space before the real game begins.
take.zh: 一夜七种不同 hook 合约接连部署，说明有人在系统性地测试组合空间——真正的江湖风雨还在后头。

narrative.en: The deck shuffles itself tonight. Fourteen new V4 pools in hours—only those the blockchain caught before midnight. One hook contract, 0x653314b5175877266fcf5f76b953e4181d262acc, takes seven consecutive deals. ETH against tokens with the same suffix 5417—serial printing, like stamping cards of the same suit. Zero fee, tickSpacing 60—standard test layout, but someone is clearly laying groundwork. Then pools with another hook, 0x627fa6f76fa96b10bae1b6fba280a3c9264500cc, twice, blocks apart. Again zero fee, but tickSpacing 200—a wider step, meaning liquidity range is spread thinner. Then 0xab78ee9dbf7b25c060e5abb3debc948406558044 enters—this hook is its own token, its own pool. Fee zero, spacing 200. A closed system. The real play is the pool at block 25326706. Fee 999300, tickSpacing 1. This isn't a step—it's a microscope. Hook 0xdfa04b8b60bf496594a3c256512409fba5a94080 takes control down to a single tick. Someone means to catch every price movement. These settings aren't for volume; they're for control. And the final chord: a pool with fee 3000 and its own hook 0x8329e7dd9454818828f1d77adef42cb0277d84c0. Same pattern: token becomes hook, hook becomes pool. Referee and player in one. No loud names, no memes. Only cold pool assembly, where each chooses the tool for the task. Some test, some print, some set an ambush. The deck is full, and every move is a bet.
narrative.zh: 夜深了，牌局自己洗牌。几个小时内冒出十四个V4池子——这只是区块链在午夜前捕捉到的。一个钩子合约，0x653314b5175877266fcf5f76b953e4181d262acc，连吃七把。ETH对上同一后缀5417的代币——批量印刷，像印同一花色的牌。零手续费，tick间距60——标准测试布局，但有人在铺路。接着另一个钩子，0x627fa6f76fa96b10bae1b6fba280a3c9264500cc，隔几个区块出现两次。还是零费，但间距200——步幅更大，流动性范围铺得更薄。然后0xab78ee9dbf7b25c060e5abb3debc948406558044入场——这个钩子自己就是代币，自己就是池子。零费，间距200。封闭系统。最妙的是区块25326706上的池子。手续费999300，tick间距1。这不是步长——是显微镜。钩子0xdfa04b8b60bf496594a3c256512409fba5a94080控制到单个tick。有人要捕捉每一次价格波动。这种设置不为量，而为控。最后一曲：手续费3000的池子，自带钩子0x8329e7dd9454818828f1d77adef42cb0277d84c0。老套路：代币变钩子，钩子变池子。自己当裁判，自己当玩家。没有响亮的名字，没有meme。只有冰冷的池子组装，每个人选自己的工具。有人在测试，有人在批量生产，有人在设伏。牌堆已满，每一步都是赌注。

take.en: The house is not dealing cards tonight—it's minting new decks, each with its own rules, and the players are becoming the game.
take.zh: 庄家今晚发的不是牌，是新的牌桌——每张桌子有自己的规矩，而玩家正在变成游戏本身。

narrative.en: The V4 deck is shuffled again, and nine new pools hit the felt overnight. The zero address dominates—eight of nine are tethered to ETH. Only two stable pairs, USDC/USDT, both at 1 bps fee and tickSpacing 1, but with different hooks: 0x8abdde86 and 0xa778c93f. This is no coincidence. Someone is preparing ultra-low slippage corridors for stable liquidity, and these two hooks will duel for dominance. The ETH pools span every fee tier: 100, 3000, 10000, and even one at zero fee. That zero-fee pool, 0x0d625293 with tickSpacing 200, is pure volume speculation—either a bid to capture the entire order book or a staging ground for MEV strategies where speed trumps cost. Two pools at fee 10000 and tickSpacing 200, on tokens 0x2ba419 and 0x595dec, signal institutional-grade instruments: wide spreads, high fees, likely with oracles or dynamic management. And then there's the WBTC pair at fee 10 and tickSpacing 1, 0xf671bcab—a BTC pair with microscopic spread and low fee. Someone wants ETH/WBTC to be the new benchmark. Watch that hook; if it carries dynamic fees, it could set the standard.
narrative.zh: V4 江湖一夜之间多了九座新池，八座以 ETH 为根基，只有两座是 USDC/USDT 的稳定币池，手续费 1 bps，tickSpacing 1，但各自挂着不同的钩子——0x8abdde86 和 0xa778c93f。这不是巧合，有人在铺设极低滑落的稳定币通道，两派钩法必将争夺内力。ETH 池的手续费层级从 100 到 3000 到 10000，甚至有一座零手续费池 0x0d625293，tickSpacing 200——纯粹赌成交量，要么想吞下整个订单簿，要么为 MEV 策略铺路，速度就是一切。两座 fee 10000 且 tickSpacing 200 的池子，分别对应 0x2ba419 和 0x595dec 令牌，宽价差、高手续费，显然不是给散户准备的，这是大侠们用的重器，可能配有预言机或动态心法。最诡异的是 WBTC 池，手续费仅 10，tickSpacing 1，地址 0xf671bcab——BTC 对居然微利差低费用，有人想让 ETH/WBTC 成为新的标杆。盯着那个钩子，若它身怀动态费用，便可能改写江湖规矩。

take.en: The house is laying out two competing stable pools and a zero-fee ETH trap—the real play is watching which hook claims the liquidity first.
take.zh: 一夜之间，两座稳定币池分庭抗礼，一座零费 ETH 池暗藏杀机——接下来就看谁的钩子先吸住流动性。

narrative.en: A new pool on V4—always that moment of stillness before the deck begins to deal. Last night, at block 25311500, someone shuffled the cards: a pair, 0x000...0000 and 0xc757...6272. The zero address is ether, a suit that needs no introduction. The second token is a dark horse, no loud name, but a contract already living on the network. The fee is set to zero. This is no mistake, no accident. In the V4 world, zero is not the absence of charge—it's an invitation. You can enter, exit, rearrange liquidity without leaving tracks at every step. TickSpacing at 200 gives a corridor narrow enough for maneuver but not for microscopic spreads. This is a bet on volume, not on speculation with a magnifying glass. The real protagonist of this deal is the hook contract: 0x0d62529346ac2c61f5c0582210d01214687bc0cc. Hooks are the jokers in the V4 deck. They can change pool logic before, after, and during a swap. Some use them for dynamic fees, some for MEV protection, some for orders that live their own lives. Here, without additional data, one can only guess what mechanics hide behind that address. Pool ID: 0x41a52bcaebea1808282d540289b41bc5a26907600b2520d8630cd2ad14804c8b. A long hash, like a fingerprint on glass. No one knows who dealt this hand, but the fact remains: a new pair is on the felt, and the first move has been made. The rest will watch how the cards fall.
narrative.zh: V4上又开新池子，江湖上总得静一静，等牌发完。昨夜，区块25311500，有人洗了牌：一对，0x000...0000和0xc757...6272。零地址是ETH，江湖上谁不认识这位老侠客。另一个代币，名不见经传，但合约已在链上活着。手续费设为零。这不是失误，不是巧合。V4江湖里，零不是不要钱，是请帖。你可以进，可以出，可以挪动内力，不必每一步都留痕迹。TickSpacing设200，够窄，能走位，但不至于细到显微镜下玩。这是赌量，不是赌眼力。真正的暗棋是那个钩子合约：0x0d62529346ac2c61f5c0582210d01214687bc0cc。钩子，V4牌局里的百搭牌。它们能在交换前、交换中、交换后改变池子的规矩。有人用它调动态手续费，有人用它防MEV偷袭，有人用它造活着的订单。这里，没更多消息，只能猜这钩子后面藏着什么功夫。池子ID：0x41a52bcaebea1808282d540289b41bc5a26907600b2520d8630cd2ad14804c8b。一串长印，像玻璃上的指痕。没人知道谁发的这手牌，但牌已上桌，第一招已出。剩下的，看牌怎么落。

take.en: A zero-fee pool with a hook contract is a signal that someone is building a new game on V4—the house is letting you play for free, but the real action is in the hook.
take.zh: 零手续费加钩子合约，这是有人在V4上立新门派——庄家请客，但真正的功夫在钩子里。

narrative.en: The deal's already in motion. Fifteen pools across seventy blocks—not a ripple, a salvo. Same hook contract, same pattern: ETH against tokens with the 5417 suffix. Zero fee, tick spacing 60. As if someone's running the deck through an automated shoe. The pools are initialized back-to-back: block 25305000, then 25305002, 25305005, and so on, almost without pause. Between 25305064 and 25305065, just one block. This isn't chance. It's rhythm. Someone's sitting on a script, stamping them out like a conveyor belt. Every time, ETH on one side, some fresh token on the other. None of those addresses have ever appeared in known liquidity. Clean sheets. The hook 0x1b15...aacc is the only one signing off on all these pools. He's the conductor of this orchestra. The strangest part: why fifteen identical pools when you could make one with different ranges? The answer lies in V4's logic—hooks can change pool behavior dynamically. Maybe each of these pools is a separate experimental cell. Or a testing ground for some algorithm. Or maybe it's just a new deck being dealt. Fifteen cards, 5417 suit. We're watching to see who takes the first.
narrative.zh: 江湖上最近出了件怪事。十五个池子，七十个区块内接连出世——不是散兵游勇，而是齐刷刷的排阵。同一个钩子合约，同一个路数：以太坊对后缀5417的令牌。零手续费，刻度间距六十。像是有人在用机关枪发牌。这些池子初始化得紧挨着：25305000块，接着25305002，25305005，几乎不停歇。25305064和25305065之间只隔了一个区块。这不是巧合，是节奏。有人写了脚本，像流水线一样往外印。每次都是以太坊一边，新令牌一边。那些地址从没在已知的流动性里出现过。白纸一张。钩子0x1b15...aacc是所有这些池子的唯一签名人。他是这个乐队的指挥。最怪的是：既然一个池子能设不同区间，为什么非要造十五个一模一样的？答案在V4的逻辑里——钩子能动态改变池子行为。也许每个池子都是一间独立的实验舱。或者某个算法的试验场。又或者，有人在发一副新牌。十五张牌，5417花色。看谁先接牌。

take.en: Someone is dealing a new deck of identical pools with a single hook—this is a systematic test, not random noise.
take.zh: 有人在用同一个钩子批量发牌，十五个一模一样的池子——这不是乱拳，是有人在练新招。

narrative.en: The deck was dealt yesterday in a single pattern—five pools on the same hook contract, 0x6c24d0bcc264ef6a740754a11ca579b9d225e8cc, all with fee 8388608 and tickSpacing 200. Every pair paired WETH against an unknown token, launched block after block, methodical as a croupier turning cards. No surprises, no exotic names—just clean, sterile symmetry. Then the deck reshuffled. Three pools appeared with native ETH against three different tokens, fee dropped to 100, tickSpacing to 1. Different hook contracts, same serial production. No loud names, only addresses. And then—seven pools in a single block, block 25297090. One hook contract, 0xefe3aa7df4ebfc8c162ec957fdd617455d9d0088. Fee zero. TickSpacing 10. All pairs tied to USDC. Seven tokens against one stable. Someone wanted to build a liquidity grid without fees—or test a strategy where yield comes from something other than swaps. What catches the eye: none of these pools use standard Uniswap V3 fees. 8388608 is not 0.3% or 0.05%. It's a custom binary. Zero fee is a different story—possible in V4 with hooks, but rare in such volume in a single block. Someone is clearly assembling a deck. Either a bot or a team with a plan. The question is what they'll do with these pools next. So far, just initializations. No volume, no movement. The cards are dealt, but the game hasn't started.
narrative.zh: 昨夜江湖，牌局套路分明。五个池子同出一门——同一钩子合约 0x6c24d0bcc264ef6a740754a11ca579b9d225e8cc，手续费 8388608，tickSpacing 200，全是 WETH 对无名代币，一个区块接一个区块，像是有人在按顺序发牌。没有意外，没有花哨，干干净净的流水线。接着牌局一变。三个池子用原生 ETH 对三种不同代币，手续费降到 100，tickSpacing 降到 1。钩子合约不同，但手法一样：批量生产。没有响亮的名号，只有地址。然后——一个区块里冒出七个池子。区块 25297090。同一个钩子合约 0xefe3aa7df4ebfc8c162ec957fdd617455d9d0088。手续费为零。tickSpacing 10。所有池子都绑着 USDC。七种代币对同一个稳定币。有人想搭一张免手续费的流动性网——或者是在测试一种不从交换赚钱的策略。最扎眼的是：这些池子没一个用 Uniswap V3 的标准费率。8388608 不是 0.3% 也不是 0.05%，是自定义的二进制数。零费率更是另一回事——V4 钩子能做到，但一个区块里出现这么多，少见。有人在摆牌。要么是机器人，要么是有计划的团队。问题是他们接下来要拿这些池子做什么。目前只是初始化。没有成交量，没有动静。牌已发完，但局还没开。

take.en: The house is stacking custom-fee pools in silence—when the volume comes, the edge will be theirs.
take.zh: 庄家在暗处布下自定义费率的池子——等流水一来，赢面就在他们手里。

narrative.en: The deal's already on the table before the first chip is laid. Block 25290599 shows a V4 pool, and the first thing that hits the felt is the zero-address paired with 0x748249be31ab2c05450b4a2c328d68028df09ab9 — not some random token, but the unmistakable signature of native currency wrapped in hook logic. The commission is 500, a standard play for mid-frequency pairs, neither aggressive nor dead. Tick spacing of 10 means a fine grid, someone expecting tight liquidity in a narrow range — not for wild candle swings, but for quiet scalping or stable swaps. The real tell is the hook contract at 0x9963ad53742fb596bc9c1ae5178d850b05d10144. V4 without hooks is a deck without jokers. This contract can shift fees dynamically, add limit orders, manage liquidity against oracles. Right now it's just appeared, but its behavior is the key to the pool's strategy. Pool ID 0xc6fc02... — long as a vault number, each one a unique combination of tokens, fee, and hook settings. This isn't standard Uniswap, it's a custom build. The pool's empty for now, but the code's on the table. The question isn't whether liquidity will show, but who will place it and how. Hooks aren't decoration — they're tools to intercept control. If this contract can influence swaps or redistribute fees, we'll see unusual dynamics. I'm watching the hook. Its first calls will tell what game they're running.
narrative.zh: 江湖上又起了一座新寨。25290599号区块，V4池子刚立，眼尖的已经看见——零地址配上了0x748249be31ab2c05450b4a2c328d68028df09ab9。这不是寻常令牌，是原生币裹着钩子逻辑的暗号。佣金五百，不高不低，中频路数，不凶不僵。tick间距十格，细网密布，有人要在窄巷子里摆摊——不是给大起大落的浪人，是给稳扎稳打的刀客。真正的杀招在钩子合约：0x9963ad53742fb596bc9c1ae5178d850b05d10144。V4没有钩子，就像剑客没有剑鞘。这钩子能调佣金、挂限价单、借预言机控流动性。现在它刚露面，但一动就露底。池子ID 0xc6fc02...，长如密匣暗码，每个ID都是令牌、佣金、钩子的独门配方。这不是寻常的Uniswap，是定制工坊。池子现在还空着，但图纸已经摊开。问题不是有没有人来，是谁来，怎么摆。钩子不是装饰，是夺权的暗器。若这合约能调换汇路、分佣金，那就有好戏看了。我盯着钩子，它头一回出手，就能看出是哪门哪派的功夫。

take.en: The hook is the play — its first execution reveals the strategy behind the pool.
take.zh: 钩子才是真章，它头一回出手，池子的底牌就亮了。

narrative.en: The deal's on the felt again, twelve fresh V4 pools initialized in the last two thousand blocks. Look at the pattern: nine of them pair WETH against a memecoin or a low-liquidity token — the native ETH address 0x000...000 is the constant. One pool is a strange token pair without ETH, and two more are WETH against specific addresses. The house is methodically dealing a deck built on ether-plus-something-new. Fee rates are zero in almost all cases — only three break the pattern: one dynamic at 8388608, one standard 0.3% at 3000, and one at 100 with tick spacing 1, which is practically a static range. Zero fees across a pile of pools isn't about trading; it's about hook contracts. They're the real players here. Look at the hook addresses: 0x4aad...2000, 0xcca9...6000, 0x16df...2080, 0xc3f7...0cc, 0x87fe...0000, 0x71af...04cc, 0x78b8...0000, 0x6c24...e8cc, 0x0aa4...8044, 0xc17c...4144, 0xb8ff...0000. Many end in round numbers — 0, 2000, 6000, 0000, 0cc, 04cc. That's no accident. Either pre-deployed contracts with specific logic or test deployments. The hooks are the brains of these pools — they decide liquidity distribution, who can swap, what triggers fire. Tick spacing is 60 almost everywhere, except one WETH pool with token 0x5c58... at spacing 200 — wider, less precision, but deeper. That one might not be a meme; it could carry real volume. Interesting.
narrative.zh: 江湖又起风了。十二个新的 V4 池子，在过去两千个区块里悄然初始化。扫一眼牌面，九成都是 WETH 对某个 meme 币或低流动性代币——原生 ETH 地址 0x000...000 是常客。一个池子没有 ETH，是奇怪的代币配对，还有两个是 WETH 对特定地址。有人在按套路出牌，摆的是‘以太加新货’的阵。手续费几乎全是零，只有三个例外：一个动态费率 8388608，一个标准 0.3% 的 3000，还有一个 tick spacing 为 1、费率 100 的，近乎静态区间。零费率堆在一起，不是给交易用的——是给 hook 合约的。它们才是这盘棋的执棋人。看这些 hook 地址：0x4aad...2000、0xcca9...6000、0x16df...2080、0xc3f7...0cc、0x87fe...0000、0x71af...04cc、0x78b8...0000、0x6c24...e8cc、0x0aa4...8044、0xc17c...4144、0xb8ff...0000。好多结尾是整整齐齐的数字——0、2000、6000、0000、0cc、04cc。这不是巧合。要么是预先部署好的合约，带着特定逻辑；要么是测试部署。Hook 是这些池子的内功心法——它们决定流动性怎么走、谁能换、什么触发。Tick spacing 几乎全是 60，只有一个 WETH 对 0x5c58... 的池子用了 200——更宽，精度低，但深度大。那个可能不是 meme，或许有真功夫。有意思。

take.en: The house is dealing a quiet hand: twelve V4 pools, zero fees, hook-driven — this isn't a trade floor, it's a laboratory.
take.zh: 江湖夜雨，十二池无声起——零费率、hook 驱动，这不是赌桌，是演武场。

narrative.en: Twelve fresh V4 pools hit the felt in a single night, hooks and all, dealt out block by block like a slow roll. The first hand opened with a zero-address token and 0x49a..., thirty basis points on the vig, tick sixty. The hook contract 0x8048... had already been spotted in earlier rounds—nothing new under the house lights. Then came USDC/USDT, zero fee, tick one—the classic stablecoin corridor, but with hooks from a different deck, 0x2cf7..., a face I hadn't seen before. Another zero-address pair followed with 0x69b5..., tick two hundred, and the same hook set 0x96b8... that would show up again later with 0x693e.... Mid-block at 25276538, a token 0x5b76... paired with hooks 0xeeb8...—a fresh contract, no history on the table. From there, five pools in a row, a run of familiar hooks 0xb453... mixed with new ones: 0x068f..., 0x2ad8..., 0x6c24.... The outlier came at block 25275975: tokens 0x268b... and WETH, commission 8,388,608—that's no typo, eight million three hundred eighty-eight thousand six hundred eight. Tick two hundred, hooks 0x6c24.... That kind of fee suggests something off-book, maybe dynamic pricing or a custom logic trap. The last pool of the night closed with token 0x0f35..., hooks 0x9676..., zero fee, tick sixty. Final block: 25276648. Not a single hook contract repeated across the entire deal—every one unique. Someone's running a full suite of tests in one session, mixing stablecoins, memes, and WETH pairs like a dealer shuffling suits. V4 with hooks isn't an experiment anymore; it's the new routine. The night shift is over, but the house is still taking bets.
narrative.zh: 一夜之间，十二个新的V4池子带着钩子落桌，几十个区块的间隔里，牌局没停过。第一手是零地址和0x49a...代币，三十基点手续费，步长六十——钩子合约0x8048...之前已经亮过相，不算生面孔。接着USDC/USDT上场，零费率，步长一，典型的稳定币走廊，但钩子换了，0x2cf7...，不是老熟人。然后又一对零地址配0x69b5...，步长两百，钩子0x96b8...，后来又在0x693e...的池子里露了脸。区块25276538中段跳出一个池子，代币0x5b76...，钩子0xeeb8...——全新合约，江湖上没听过。之后一连五个池子，老钩子0xb453...和新面孔0x068f...、0x2ad8...、0x6c24...交替登场。最扎眼的是区块25275975那个池子：代币0x268b...配WETH，手续费8388608——不是笔误，八百三十八万八千六百零八。步长两百，钩子0x6c24...。这个费率不像常规路子，要么是动态定价，要么藏着什么特殊逻辑。最后一手在区块25276648收场，代币0x0f35...，钩子0x9676...，零费率，步长六十。整晚十二个池子，钩子合约一个没重样——每个都是独门。有人在一次交易会话里试遍了不同策略，稳定币、迷因、WETH对子，花色全混着来。V4带钩子已经不是试验了，成了日常。夜场散了，但庄家还在发牌。

take.en: Twelve unique hook contracts in one night, zero repeats—someone is stress-testing the V4 playbook, and the market is the lab.
take.zh: 十二个钩子合约一夜之间全换了新面孔，一个重复的都没有——有人在拿市场当练功房，V4这套拳法已经打熟了。

narrative.en: The night was quiet, but the Uniswap V4 deck is being reshuffled with fresh force. Two fresh hook-enabled pools have cracked the GeckoTerminal top 50: CTM/ETH with volume just shy of two and a half million and TVL of two million, and OPN/USDT 0.3%—one point five million in volume, one point one million in liquidity. Someone is clearly testing new mechanics, sliding liquidity into off-suit hands. The ETH/USDT 0.05% pair added 110% to its volume—172 million in a single day. That's no ripple; that's a wave. DAI/ETH 0.3% posted 135% volume growth and a 338% TVL surge to 21.5 million. A stablecoin paired with ether is gaining traction, as if someone is quietly building a position under the noise. Meanwhile, cbBTC/WBTC 0.005% tanked 85% to four million. Bitcoin pairs are losing their grip, ceding ground to ether's deals. Among the top five hooks by volume, the picture is clear: ETH/USDT 0.05% leads, followed by USDC/USDT at 145 million, USDT/USDS at 46.5, DAI/ETH at 41.4, and USDe/USDT 0.005% closing with 11 million. Stable pairs dominate, but the ether suit is cutting through with increasing aggression. A separate line: tweets from @unipegv4. A retweet about ethereum:native, another about the community starting to mint merch around address 0x44b2...125505. The idea: a store selling goods for USDT, with profits flowing into the treasury. For now, it's a whisper, but if the community picks it up, it could spark a new wave of liquidity. The V4 deck is revealing itself not through loud listings, but through quiet experiments with hooks and organic volume growth. Those who track these currents see how the market's structure is shifting—not on exchanges, but inside the pools themselves.
narrative.zh: 昨夜江湖风平浪静，但Uniswap V4这盘棋，暗流涌动。GeckoTerminal前五十名里，两个新池子悄然杀入：CTM/ETH，成交二百五十万，锁仓二百万；OPN/USDT 0.3%，成交一百五十万，流动性一百一十万。有人在试新招式，把内力注入非常规的池子。ETH/USDT 0.05%日成交暴涨110%，一亿七千二百万——这不是涟漪，是浪头。DAI/ETH 0.3%成交涨135%，锁仓量狂飙338%，冲到两千一百五十万。稳定币配以太坊，像是有人趁乱悄悄布阵。反观cbBTC/WBTC 0.005%，暴跌85%，只剩四百万。比特币门派的气力在消退，以太坊的牌面越来越硬。交易量前五的钩子池，格局分明：ETH/USDT 0.05%领跑，USDC/USDT一亿四千五百万紧随，USDT/USDS四千六百五十万，DAI/ETH四千一百四十万，USDe/USDT 0.005%收尾一千万。稳定币对子占山为王，但以太坊的剑气越来越凌厉。另一条线：@unipegv4的推文。转推了ethereum:native，又转推社区开始围绕地址0x44b2...125505做周边。主意是开个店，卖货收USDT，利润归金库。眼下只是风声，但若社区响应，可能引来新一波内力。V4这盘棋，不是靠大张旗鼓的上线，而是靠钩子实验和成交量的自然生长。看透这些暗流的人，才明白市场筋骨在变——不在交易所，而在池子深处。

take.en: The V4 deck is not about splashy listings; it's about silent hook experiments and organic volume growth—the market's structure is rewriting itself inside the pools, not on the order books.
take.zh: V4这盘棋，不在大张旗鼓的上线，而在钩子实验和成交量的暗涌——市场的筋骨，正在池子深处重写。

narrative.en: The chain logged a tokenization night. Uniswap and unipegv4 dropped the same word — 'Tokenization' — into the tape simultaneously. No context, no explanation. Just a mark sewn into the ribbon. Some will call it coincidence, but I've seen the deck shuffled from both hands in the same rhythm. uPEG keeps moving. Fifth place by MR shifted from @cutepanda to @DBSdabaisha. The community overflowed the first two groups, a third opened. Unicorns gather in a herd — this isn't noise, it's structure. When holders shift positions not through orders but through direct hands, the deck changes weight. On the other side of the suit, UNI burned a new daily record — 186,000 tokens in 24 hours. Burning accelerates, while Bankr crossed $4B+ in total volume on the Uniswap protocol. Numbers don't lie: the mechanism runs to exhaustion, and the ash from burned tokens settles on rising volume. The deep distribution on GeckoTerminal shows where real liquidity lives. USDC/USDT on V4 hook pools — $308 million in a day. That's not a speculative spike, it's base infrastructure. ETH/USDT 0.05% jumped 1286% in volume to $82 million, with TVL up 198%. People are moving capital into tight spreads. DAI/ETH reversed — volume up 140%, but TVL down 87%. Someone's pulling collateral but keeps trading. HaydenzAdams tweeted a link to the latest version — no explanation, just 'this is current.' And @lo0pio replied in thread: 'Bear markets for building.' Bears build. Everything else is noise. The night showed: tokenization isn't a word, it's a process. The deck is being reshuffled mid-hand.
narrative.zh: 链上昨夜刻下了一道‘代币化’的印记。Uniswap 和 unipegv4 同时扔出同一个词——‘Tokenization’——没有上下文，没有解释。只是嵌入链带的一个标记。有人会说这是巧合，但我见过两副牌用同一只手洗。uPEG 仍在移动。MR 第五把交椅从 @cutepanda 换到了 @DBSdabaisha。社区挤满了一群和二群，三群已经开启。独角兽聚集成群——这不是杂音，这是结构。当持有者不通过订单、而是直接用手转移仓位时，牌局的重心就变了。另一面，UNI 烧出了新的日纪录——24 小时内 186,000 枚代币。燃烧在加速，而 Bankr 在 Uniswap 协议上的总交易量突破了 40 亿美元。数字不会说谎：机制在极限运转，烧毁的灰烬落在增长的量上。GeckoTerminal 上的深度分布揭示了真实流动性所在。USDC/USDT 在 V4 hook 池——单日 3.08 亿美元。这不是投机性的脉冲，这是底层基础设施。ETH/USDT 0.05% 交易量飙升 1286% 至 8200 万美元，TVL 增长 198%。人们正把资本注入窄利差。DAI/ETH 则相反——交易量增长 140%，但 TVL 下跌 87%。有人在抽走抵押品，却继续交易。HaydenzAdams 发了一条推文，链接到最新版本——没有解释，只是‘这是最新的’。而 @lo0pio 在回复中写道：‘熊市是用来建设的。’熊在建设。其他都是杂音。昨夜揭示了：代币化不是词汇，而是过程。牌局正在行进中重新洗牌。

take.en: Tokenization is the mark on the felt; the deck is already moving beneath it.
take.zh: 代币化是刻在江湖上的印记；牌局已在暗处重新洗过。

narrative.en: The table's been dealt a fresh hand, and the first card to hit the felt comes from Hayden Adams himself. He didn't just wake up bullish—he woke up with a message that cuts through the noise like a knife through a dealer's deck. He's been talking to the biggest asset managers on the planet—sovereign funds, family offices, endowments—and they all want one thing: hard infrastructure. Not products, not tokens, but the rails society runs on. He said it twice. That's not a slip, that's a tell. Then he doubled down: bullish on DeFi, bullish on Ethereum, and he threw a nod to 2018, when Uniswap launched into a bear market and Ethereum sentiment was in the gutter. They built then, and it led to DeFi Summer. He's saying the same thing now, but the clock reads 2026. The house is reshuffling, and the smart money's already reading the cards.
narrative.zh: 牌局刚开，海登·亚当斯先落了一子。他不是随便醒来的——他带着两记重拳走出暗巷。第一拳：他跟全球最大的资产管理人聊过——主权基金、家族办公室、捐赠基金——他们要的不是产品，是硬基础设施。他重复了两遍，这不是口误，是江湖暗号。第二拳：他看多DeFi和以太坊，顺手翻出2018年的旧账——那年Uniswap在熊市中起跑，以太坊被踩到谷底，结果呢？DeFi Summer。现在他说同样的话，但时间已是2026年。江湖在洗牌，内力深厚的门派已经在暗中蓄力。同时，Cap Token Auction开始走位：起始FDV七千五百万美元，预竞价从6月8日启动，平台是Uniswap Auctions——这套功法，海登自己说过是协议的关键。池子也在动：USDC/USDT在V4上日交易量两亿两千万美元，USDT/USDS暴增411%到一亿一千一百万——这不是套利，是流动资金在找归宿。sUSDe/USDT闯入GeckoTerminal前五十，日交易量六百万，TVL四千三百万——稳定币江湖越拧越紧。海登对某人回了一句：'一切终归基本面。我对Uniswap协议的未来极度看多。如果有人想在路上烧更多UNI——我有什么好抱怨的？'他不劝人下注，他只是摊开牌面。

take.en: The deal is clear: the biggest players want infrastructure, not products, and DeFi is being rebuilt in the bear—just like before.
take.zh: 大玩家要的是硬功夫，不是花招——DeFi在熊市中重练内功，历史不会简单重复，但韵脚总在回荡。

narrative.en: The night's deal came off a different shuffle. Three contracts—Slonks, sato, uPEG—verified in a single day, each with its own compiler, each silent on its suit. Versions 0.8.30, 0.8.26, 0.8.33 scattered like a deck gathered from separate tables. No tickets, no announcements. Just facts on Etherscan, and nothing more. The house deals, but it doesn't explain the hand. Uniswap rolls out an in-app wallet through Privy—no seed phrase, FaceID and passkey only. Hayden writes he's been through the regulator's wringer for the right to build open software. Now a user can create a wallet in seconds, then export the seed if they choose. This isn't a UX patch—it's a paradigm shift: entry without fear, exit without loss of control. Privy confirms: Uniswap uses their tech. One tweet just says 'You love to see it 🦄.' And that's all. On the side, the Strato auction from Uniswap Auctions runs until June 11. Pull factor: new coin, new round, new stake. Loop launches lending from idle liquidity. Borrow against a token at contract 0x6982...1933. No name, no context—just an address and the phrase 'Idle liquidity is finally getting put to work.' Someone clearly knows what sits in that contract and bets the liquidity will stop being dead. V4 hooks show the usual picture: USDC/USDT at $355M in a day, USDT/USDS at $21.7M with 156% growth, cbBTC/WBTC at $15M, ETH/WBTC at $8.6M. Stable pairs dominate, but the USDS pair adds volume—maybe someone is shifting or hedging. You have three unrevealed contracts, a new Uniswap wallet, an auction, a lending protocol, and stable hooks. The deck is assembled. The only question is who moves first.
narrative.zh: 夜里的牌局换了套路。Slonks、sato、uPEG——三个合约，一天内验证通过，各自用不同的编译器，各自沉默不语。版本号0.8.30、0.8.26、0.8.33散落一地，像是有人从不同的赌桌凑了一副牌。没有公告，没有风声。只有Etherscan上的事实，再无其他。江湖上，有人悄悄布了三枚暗棋，却无人知晓它们的门派。Uniswap通过Privy推出了内置钱包——无需助记词，只用FaceID和passkey。Hayden说，为了能建开放软件，他和监管层周旋到了极限。现在用户几秒就能建一个钱包，之后如果想，也可以导出助记词。这不止是用户体验的修补——这是范式的转变：入场无惧，离场不失控。Privy确认：Uniswap用了他们的技术。一条推文只说了一句‘You love to see it 🦄。’就这些。另一边，Uniswap Auctions的Strato拍卖持续到6月11日。拉力因素：新币、新轮、新注。Loop推出了从闲置流动性中借贷的服务。借出对象是合约0x6982...1933上的代币。没有名字，没有背景——只有一个地址和一句话：‘闲置的流动性终于被派上用场了。’显然有人知道那个合约里藏着什么，押注流动性不再沉寂。V4钩子显示熟悉的景象：USDC/USDT一天35.5亿美元，USDT/USDS 2.17亿美元增长156%，cbBTC/WBTC 1.5亿美元，ETH/WBTC 8600万美元。稳定对占据主导，但USDS对在放量——也许有人在调仓或对冲。你有三个未揭晓的合约、一个Uniswap新钱包、一场拍卖、一个借贷协议、还有稳定的钩子。牌已齐备。问题只在于——谁先出手。

take.en: Three silent contracts, a wallet without a seed, and idle liquidity finding its edge—the table is set, but the cards are still face down.
take.zh: 三枚暗棋、一个无种钱包、还有闲置内力找到了出口——棋局已布，但牌面仍扣在桌上。

narrative.en: The deck is dealing itself tonight, and I'm just watching the cards fall. @lo0pio keeps shuffling the same theme — Lo0p Pools, $2.5 billion in idle liquidity he wants to bring back into play. He doesn't ask, he states. 'The world wants DeFi' is no longer a slogan, it's a rhyme that @Uniswap and @unipegv4 pick up, and you can't tell who's quoting whom. The deck speaks to itself. On the felt, the numbers: USDT/USDS jumped 76% in a day, to $8.4 million. But that's not the main event. A new AZTEC/ETH 0.05% pool slid into the GeckoTerminal top 50 with $3 million in volume and $14.5 million TVL. Someone played that card in silence, no noise. ETH/WBTC 0.05% saw volume climb 95% to $9.4 million, but TVL cratered 53%. That means the same money is chasing its tail, never settling. Nobody wants to hold. The top slots are old friends: USDC/USDT leads steady at $266 million. But look at the top five: USDe/USDT, cbBTC/WBTC, ETH/WBTC, USDT/USDS. These aren't just stable pairs. This is structure. Someone is building bridges between synthetics, wrapped assets, and stablecoins. The question isn't who wins, but which suit becomes trump in the next deal. And at the end — a closed PR #93 in v4-template from hunterinvariants: 'Add optional Hunter invariant workflow.' Sounds like a technical note, but it's a guardrail. Someone is putting protection against value loss. When the deck shuffles this fast, that's not just code. It's a sign: the game is getting harder, and the stakes are higher.
narrative.zh: 牌局自己翻开了，我只是看着。@lo0pio 反复洗同一副牌——Lo0p Pools，250亿美元闲置内力，他想让它们重新入江湖。他不是在问，是在说。'世界想要DeFi'，这已经不是口号，是韵脚，@Uniswap 和 @unipegv4 跟着念，你已经分不清谁在引谁。牌自己说话。桌上数字：USDT/USDS 一天涨了76%，到840万。但这不算主菜。新池子 AZTEC/ETH 0.05% 静悄悄进了 GeckoTerminal 前50，成交量300万，内力1450万。有人无声出牌。ETH/WBTC 0.05% 成交量涨95%，到940万，但内力跌了53%。意思是同一笔钱在转圈，没人想留。上头几把交椅是老面孔：USDC/USDT 稳在2.66亿。但看前五：USDe/USDT、cbBTC/WBTC、ETH/WBTC、USDT/USDS。这不是稳定对。这是骨架。有人在搭桥，连起合成资产、包裹资产和稳定币。问题不是谁赢，是下一把什么花色成王牌。最后——v4-template 里有个闭门 PR #93，来自 hunterinvariants：'添加可选 Hunter 不变性工作流。'听着像技术笔记，其实是护栏。有人在防价值流失。牌洗得这么快，这不是代码。是信号：江湖变硬了，赌注更高了。

take.en: The house is tightening the rails — the next round won't be for the faint of heart.
take.zh: 庄家在收窄护栏——下一轮不是给心软的人玩的。
